content.text: Treikort is a unique Icelandic trick-taking game for exactly three players using a specially selected 27-card deck. The game features 'BÃ­sefarnir' (Sevens) that are unbeatable when led but worthless when following. A 'Pope' title is earned by winning 13 tricks across 3 consecutive games, granting card-swapping privileges.

Treikort was played widely in Iceland up to the last century. Old Danish games manuals describe a different game also called Treikort; the Icelandic form is distinct. It is sometimes called "3-man Alkort". The game is documented in Ólafur Davíðsson's writings on Icelandic amusements (1887–1903, Copenhagen) and in Spilabók AB by Þ. Guðmundsson (1989, Reykjavík).
